''See also: [[Herald Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|A Herald is a powerful entity that exists as a rank above an [[Archlord]], serving as the precursor to becoming a [[Monarch]]. Unlike [[Sages]], who focus their willpower externally to manipulate the world, [[Heralds]] direct their power inward to enhance their own capabilities and transcend physical or spiritual limitations. This process results in a complete unification of the individual's spirit and body, allowing them to shift freely between physical and spiritual forms. While this internal focus makes them incredibly strong, it also renders them unable to interact with [[Icons]] in the way [[Sages]] do; whereas a [[Sage]] can read an [[Icon]], a Herald is effectively blind to it. Achieving the rank of Herald typically requires reaching the peak of the [[Archlord]] stage through significant brute force and the accumulation of vast resources. Those who attempt to advance too quickly or without proper stability may become incomplete "pseudo-[[Heralds]]," characterized by an imbalance between their merged spirit and body. In various cultures, [[Heralds]] have been identified by specific colors on badges, such as red, to distinguish them from [[Monarchs]]. [[Heralds]] serve diverse roles across the world, acting as high-ranking officials for empires, protectors of nature, or leaders of organizations like [[Redmoon Hall]].}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|A Herald is a specific type of beast whose true nature remains a secret to anyone below the rank of [[Archlord]]. These entities, such as [[Xorrus]], possess bodies that are unified with their spirits and can shift between physical and spiritual forms. This unique power allows a Herald to pit the full strength of their will against an opponent. While [[Fury]] keeps a watchful eye for these creatures, the Herald of the [[dragons]] has yet to descend from a thousand feet up to annihilate the [[dragons]]. Furthermore, excessive killing of cultists carries the risk of attracting the attention of an enemy Herald.}}

== Reaper ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The rank of Herald represents a powerful stage of [[advancement]], such as when [[Lindon]]'s progression to this level would elevate him to a [[Monarch]]. Those at this stage, including [[Yerin]] and the late [[Reigan Shen]], possess immense [[Spiritual pressure|spiritual pressure]] and a unique connection between their body and spirit. [[Heralds]] are capable of utilizing techniques that obscure [[spiritual perception]] or manifesting as black-and-white copies of historical experts. In combat, a Herald can move with such blurring speed that they weave through arrows, and their specialized [[Remnants]] are capable of being tempered in [[Archlord soulfire]]. Furthermore, while it is believed only [[Sages]] or [[Heralds]] can survive and manipulate the workings of a [[labyrinth]], certain creatures have been described as possessing spiritual presences equivalent to multiple [[Heralds]] stitched together.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">11</span></div>

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|A Herald is a member of the [[The Eight-Man Empire|Eight-Man Empire]] and represents a specific stage of [[advancement]]. While [[Heralds]] are expected to possess greater physical strength than [[Sages]], [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] viewed his own status as more aligned with a Herald. These beings possess bodies as tough as an [[Archlord]]'s and are invulnerable to any forces lacking will, though they can be pushed back by [[Sages]]. Capable of flying through portals, a newborn Herald was seen appearing on the deck of [[Redmoon Hall]]. Furthermore, the techniques used by the [[King's army]] are collectively comparable to a Herald, and one such entity was able to walk directly into the strongholds of [[Malice]].}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The rank of Herald represents a significant [[advancement]] goal for [[Little Blue]] and a potential path for [[Mercy]]. To reach this stage, spirits must form themselves into a body to achieve the necessary physical state. While the [[Path of Seven Pages]] prepares the spirit for this transition, the seventh page of the Book contains energy specifically meant to lead one to Herald and is intended for mastery once the rank is attained. Achieving this status can be aided by the Twin [[dragons|Dragon]] Rejuvenation Pill, which helps [[Archlord|Archlords]] synchronize their spirit and body. Although an average Herald is difficult to capture, [[Yerin]] has successfully killed one, and [[Mercy]] possesses the ability to borrow a Herald's power. At one point, [[Orthos]] and [[Little Blue]] existed as a new [[Sage]] and Herald.}}
